title: A Genome Wide CRISPR Screen Reveals That HOXA9 Promotes Enzalutamide Resistance in Prostate Cancer
model: LNCaP prostate cancer, genome-wide KO (71,090 guides, 142 non-cutting controls)
contrast: Enzalutamide vs DMSO at final time point (3 vs 3), median-ratio totals
paper_calls: HOXA9 validated as an enzalutamide-sensitizer (loss sensitizes)
barcs_calls: 88 genes at FDR 0.10 with median-ratio totals (370 with library totals); all depleted
named_hits: HOXA9 depleted in the paper's direction (p 0.009-0.044) but rank ~1000, not at FDR 0.10; RB1 enriched (resistance), consistent with the paper
verdict: The final enzalutamide libraries are severely bottlenecked, so depletion calls swing 88 vs 370 with normalization and the 142 non-cutting controls (0% at p<0.05) cannot calibrate the test; HOXA9 depletes in the paper's sensitizer direction and RB1 enriches as expected, but the deposited counts do not single out HOXA9 at FDR.
